comment.text: PRSS27 V246 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1. Source observations include Adrenocortical carcinoma; Papillary renal cell carcinoma; Low-grade glioma. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position. This site is present only in the historical V1 material in this collection.

report_comment.text: Somatic alterations affecting PRSS27 residue V246 have been observed in adrenocortical carcinoma, low-grade glioma, and papillary renal cell carcinoma. The functional and clinical significance depend on the specific alteration and tumor type.
